topics.topic: Minnesota Department of Human Services fraud
topics.description: Recent developments indicate a significant focus on fraud within the Minnesota Department of Human Services (DHS). A 56-page roadmap for fraud prevention was submitted to Gov. Walz and lawmakers. Additionally, Shireen Gandhi was appointed as the permanent commissioner of DHS. These actions follow a report highlighting Minnesota's vulnerability to organized fraud since the 1970s.
topics.reason: Increased scrutiny on DHS and state fraud prevention efforts
